title: Cosmic Candy Ballet
description: A young girl with pigtails wearing a pink tutu and red gloves roller skates with arms outstretched on a swirling rainbow candy path. She stands before a massive glowing cosmic portal showing a vibrant galaxy and starburst, surrounded by floating crystals, comets, pink clouds, and a surreal landscape of chocolate mountains and candy formations.
